name: catalog_price_sequences
description: Each catalog's price change counter: every base price, branch price or promotion change adds one under this row's lock, so changes are numbered in commit order and publications record which ones they include.
lifecycle: Inserted with a catalog's first price change and incremented by each later one; deleted with the catalog.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the catalog; immutable (tenant key).
Number of the catalog's latest committed price change.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, catalog_id) REFERENCES catalogs(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: The catalog belongs to the same company; the counter goes with it.
